description_zh: 启动一台或者多台云电脑
kebab_example: aliyun ecd start-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-id f4a0dc8e-1702-4728-9a60-95b27a350000 --login-token v18101ac6a9e69c66b04a163031680463660b4b216cd758f34b60b9ad6a7c7f7334b83dd8f75eef4209c68f9f1080b0000 --desktop-id ecd-cg27ufmapab080000 --client-token 21e7be12-aa4f-4389-b3e1-82f4a1b50000 --api-version 2020-10-02 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Workspace client (hereinafter referred to as WUYING client). The system generates a unique ID for each client
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The operating system (OS) of the device that run the client
parameters.help_zh: 运行客户端的设备的操作系统
parameters.name: client_os

parameters.help_en: The client version. If you use a WUYING client, you can click About on the client logon page to view the version of the client
parameters.help_zh: 客户端版本。若使用无影客户端，可在客户端登录界面的关于对话框中查看该参数
parameters.name: client_version

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud computers. You can specify the IDs of 1 to 20 cloud computers
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
